Yesss, your new fulltime warehouse job is here! 🥳 Work as a warehouse worker with flexible hours in the bol warehouse! Get a salary of €14,99 per hour. With shift allowances you can even get up to €22,49 per hour! 🤑 Sounds good, right?! Apply now at CEVA Logistics in Waalwijk and start your new job next week already. 🚀

What we offer
- €14,99 gross per hour (21+)
- Allowances of 10%, 25% and even 50%!

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You have your own transportation to get to Bol.com.
- You can work in Waalwijk.
- You can work day shift or evening shift.
- You are available for 4 or 5 days.

You collect products in the warehouse and bring them to the packing department. Here everything gets ready for shipment! You'll also get to try out different departments. So you can find the one you like best! Every day is a little different. And that makes it fun, right?

You can work in the day or afternoon shift. There are weekend shifts too! Perfect if you want to work some extra hours 💪

Where will you work
You'll work at CEVA Logistics for bol, 'de winkel van ons allemaal!' (that means: the shop for all of us). People from all over the world work here. So you'll quickly learn how to say 'hello' in 5 new languages!
